\caption[Bias by era and horizon band]{Mean error (bias) of $e_0$ (the average of the sexes, years; forecast minus observed) by era and horizon band, on the 15{,}261 common points.  Negative: under-predicted. Bold, underlined, italic: the best, second and third value among the twelve entries, in each column of each era, the best being the closest to zero (the naive is not ranked).}\label{tab:ev_bias_bands}\\
